dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, can you play an instrument?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈpleɪ ən ˈɪnstrəmənt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I can play the guitar. And you?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ kən ˈpleɪ ðə ɡɪˈtɑːr. ənd ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I can play the piano, but I can't play the guitar.
dialogue.reading: aɪ kən ˈpleɪ ðə piˈænoʊ, bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈpleɪ ðə ɡɪˈtɑːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My sister can play the piano, too.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈsɪstər kən ˈpleɪ ðə piˈænoʊ, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I can't play chess. It's too difficult for me.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈkænt ˈpleɪ ˈtʃɛs. ɪts ˈtuː ˈdɪfɪkəlt fər miː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's easy! I can teach you.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈiːzi! aɪ kən ˈtiːtʃ juː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! And I can teach you the guitar!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd aɪ kən ˈtiːtʃ ˈjuː ðə ɡɪˈtɑːr!
